proposal.comment: Please confirm the exact DuckDB version/build that produced this error: the report mentions both "v1.5.2" and "1.5.3". Could you paste the exact output of either `SELECT version();` (inside DuckDB) or `duckdb --version` (CLI) from the same environment that generated the INTERNAL error?
proposal.rationale: The report contains a contradictory DuckDB version (v1.5.2 in the description and 1.5.3 in the template). Exact version/build information is essential to reproduce and determine whether the issue exists in the stated release or a newer build.
